title: Desktop app crash on export with an error code
notes: Exercises error-code extraction, a partially resolved status (workaround given, root cause not fixed), and a follow-up routed to engineering. All data is synthetic.
transcript: Speaker 1: Hello, SSM Repak software support, this is Emma. How can I help?
Speaker 2: Hi Emma, my name is Marco Visser. The Repak desktop app keeps crashing whenever I try to export a report.
Speaker 1: Sorry to hear that, Marco. Do you get any error message when it crashes?
Speaker 2: Yes, it shows "Error ERR-5012, export module failed" and then the app closes.
Speaker 1: Thank you, that's helpful. Can I take your account reference?
Speaker 1: Let's try a couple of things. First, can you clear the app cache from Settings and restart it?
Speaker 2: Okay... done. It opened fine.
Speaker 1: Now try the export again.

Speaker 1: Right. Clearing the cache didn't fix the export module itself. This looks like a known bug in the current version. I've reproduced it on my side and I'll log a bug report with our engineering team.
Speaker 2: Is there anything I can do in the meantime?
Speaker 1: As a workaround you can export from the web app instead of the desktop app, that path isn't affected. The desktop fix will come in the next update.
Speaker 2: Alright, the web export works for now. Can you let me know when it's patched?
Speaker 1: I've logged bug ERR-5012 with engineering and noted your email for the fix notification.
